exclusions: tcp_flows.csv contains final ACK progress, so it has no temporal prefix.
Queue pending tables are final-cutoff measurements, not pre-T75 histories.
Queue bin flush_time/queue-at-flush and service cutoff/active-at-cutoff fields are excluded because their observation can be after T75.
Occupancy is compared in recorded order per device; synthetic held boundaries need not have global file-time order.

caveats: Device-stop, BQL-stop, literal-full occupancy and Queue drop callbacks are distinct.
TC rejection before enqueue can occur with zero Queue::DropBeforeEnqueue callbacks.
Sojourn is per served queue visit; it is not an end-to-end waiting-time sum.
Focus start/end rows hold the preceding state and do not add simulator events.
Natural pairs alone do not isolate routing causality.
Original selective forecast/policy schedule stays at T75; it is not reforecast to T78.
Both directional routes/link choices are retained until T78; the intervention is not pure RTT geometry.
Native GSLHelper uses one shared channel with no visibility/range gate; physical feasibility is not proved.
Input validation does not authorize the third simulation; independent and parent review are still required.

selective-natural.limit: Exact occupancy trace ends at77.5; later visit waits use aligned100ms bins, and source occupancy is not inferred from flush snapshots.

selective-route75-delayed78.limit: Exact occupancy trace ends at77.5; later visit waits use aligned100ms bins, and source occupancy is not inferred from flush snapshots.
